2.title: Multiple Investigations Refuted Trump’s Claims That Fraud Altered the Outcome in 2020
2.summary: Dozens of investigations, audits, recounts and court proceedings examined the 2020 election. None found the widespread voter fraud that President Trump claimed tilted the vote.

3.title: Kentucky Jury Orders Gun Kit Seller to Pay More Than $100 Million in Teen’s Death
3.summary: Lawyers for the family of Henry Coby Willis argued that the online seller failed to verify the buyer’s age or conduct a background check before shipping a pistol-building kit.

4.title: Iran War Updates: U.S. Launches New Strikes, as Tensions Escalate Over Strait of Hormuz
4.summary: American forces appeared to be focused on infrastructure, hitting bridges and a railway junction, Iranian state media reported.

5.title: Blasts reported in Iran as US launches new wave of strikes
5.summary: Iran says US strikes hit bridges in the country in an apparent escalation, while the US boards a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

6.title: At least one dead in Texas floods ravaging same area where campers died
6.summary: The same area devastated by floods last year's floods, which caused more than 130 deaths, is once again being hit.
